Using Artificial Intelligence and Large Language Models (LLMs), the platform automatically generates functional test cases, edge cases, negative test cases, and API test scenarios. The generated test cases are organized according to the original project structure, allowing developers to easily locate and use them. For example, test cases for a login page or signup page are stored within their respective folders, making integration with existing projects simple and efficient.
